text_en: There was a man of Benjamin whose name was Kish son of Abiel son of Zeror son of Becorath son of Aphiah, a Benjaminite, a man of wealth.
text_cn: 本雅明支派有个人名叫克士，他是阿彼耳的儿子，阿彼耳是责洛尔的儿子，责洛尔是贝苛辣特的儿子，贝苛辣特是阿非亚的儿子；这本雅明人是个英勇的战士。

text_en: He had a son whose name was Saul, a handsome young man. There was not a man among the people of Israel more handsome than he; he stood head and shoulders above everyone else.
text_cn: 他有个儿子名叫撒乌耳，魁梧英俊，在以色列人中没有比他更俊美的，比所有的人高出一肩。

text_en: Now the donkeys of Kish, Saul’s father, had strayed. So Kish said to his son Saul, “Take one of the boys with you; go and look for the donkeys. ”
text_cn: 撒乌耳的父亲克士有几匹母驴，走迷了路，克士遂对儿子撒乌耳说：“你带一个仆人，起身去寻找那些驴。”

text_en: He passed through the hill country of Ephraim and passed through the land of Shalishah, but they did not find them. And they passed through the land of Shaalim, but they were not there. Then he passed through the land of Benjamin, but they did not find them.
text_cn: 他们走过了厄弗辣因山地和沙里沙地方，却没有找着；又过了沙阿林地方，也没有找到；最后经过耶米尼地方，也不见踪影。

text_en: When they came to the land of Zuph, Saul said to the boy who was with him, “Let us turn back, or my father will stop worrying about the donkeys and worry about us. ”
text_cn: 当他们来到族弗地方时，撒乌耳对跟随自己的仆人说：“我们回去吧！免得我父亲不挂念驴，反而挂虑我们。”

text_en: But he said to him, “There is a man of God in this town; he is a man held in honor. Whatever he says always comes true. Let us go there now; perhaps he will tell us about the journey on which we have set out. ”
text_cn: 仆人回答他说：“请看，这城里有一位天主的人，很受敬重；凡他说的，必定应验；现在我们往那里去，或许他会告诉我们应走的路。”

text_en: Then Saul replied to the boy, “But if we go, what can we bring the man? For the bread in our sacks is gone, and there is no present to bring to the man of God. What have we? ”
text_cn: 撒乌耳回答仆人说：“好！我们可以去，但是给那人送什么呢？我们袋里的干粮已经用尽，没有礼物可以送给天主的人了。我们还有什么呢？”

text_en: The boy answered Saul again, “Here, I have with me a quarter shekel of silver; I will give it to the man of God, to tell us our way. ”
text_cn: 仆人回答撒乌耳说：“看，我手里还有四分之一‘协刻耳’银子，你可把它送给天主的人，请他把我们当走的路告诉我们。”

text_en: (Formerly in Israel, anyone who went to inquire of God would say, “Come, let us go to the seer”; for the one who is now called a prophet was formerly called a seer. )
text_cn: 撒乌耳对他的仆人说：“你说的对，来，我们去吧！”他们就往天主的人所住的城里去了。

text_en: Saul said to the boy, “Good; come, let us go. ” So they went to the town where the man of God was.
text_cn: 当他们上那城的山坡时，遇见一些少女出来打水，就问她们说：“先见者在这里吗？”──

text_en: As they went up the hill to the town, they met some girls coming out to draw water, and said to them, “Is the seer here? ”
text_cn: 过去在以色列，如果有人去求问天主，常说：“来，我们到先见者那里去！”现今所称的“先知”，就是从前称的“先见者”。 ──

text_en: They answered, “Yes, there he is just ahead of you. Hurry; he has come just now to the town, because the people have a sacrifice today at the shrine.
text_cn: 她们回答说：“是。看，先见者就在你们前面，刚刚进了城，因为今天百姓要在高丘上举行祭献。

text_en: As soon as you enter the town, you will find him, before he goes up to the shrine to eat. For the people will not eat until he comes, since he must bless the sacrifice; afterward those eat who are invited. Now go up, for you will meet him immediately. ”
text_cn: 你们进了城，在他上到高丘进食以前，一定会遇见他，因为人民在他来以前，不先吃什么，因他要祝福牺牲，然后宾客才进食。你们现在上去，立刻会遇见他。”

text_en: So they went up to the town. As they were entering the town, they saw Samuel coming out toward them on his way up to the shrine.
text_cn: 他们于是上到那城，刚进城门，看，撒慕尔就朝着他们出来，要上高丘去。

text_en: Now the day before Saul came, the Lord had revealed to Samuel:
text_cn: 在撒乌耳来的前一日，上主曾启示给撒慕尔说：

text_en: “Tomorrow about this time I will send to you a man from the land of Benjamin, and you shall anoint him to be ruler over my people Israel. He shall save my people from the hand of the Philistines; for I have seen the suffering of my people, because their outcry has come to me. ”
text_cn: “明日大约这时，我打发一个本雅明地方的人到你这里来，你要给他傅油，立他当我民以色列的首领，他要从培肋舍特人手中拯救我的百姓，因我已看到我百姓的痛苦，他们的哀号已上达于我。”

text_en: When Samuel saw Saul, the Lord told him, “Here is the man of whom I spoke to you. He it is who shall rule over my people. ”
text_cn: 撒慕尔一看见撒乌耳，上主就提醒他说：“看，这就是我曾对你提及的那人，他要统治我的百姓。”

text_en: Then Saul approached Samuel inside the gate, and said, “Tell me, please, where is the house of the seer? ”
text_cn: 撒乌耳走到撒慕尔跟前，在城门洞中问他说：“请你告诉我，先见者的家在哪里？”

text_en: Samuel answered Saul, “I am the seer; go up before me to the shrine, for today you shall eat with me, and in the morning I will let you go and will tell you all that is on your mind.
text_cn: 撒慕尔回答撒乌耳说：“我就是先见者；请你在我以前上高丘去；你们今天要同我一起吃饭，明天早晨我打发你去，你心中所怀念的事，我会全告诉你。

text_en: As for your donkeys that were lost three days ago, give no further thought to them, for they have been found. And on whom is all Israel’s desire fixed, if not on you and on all your ancestral house? ”
text_cn: 至于三天以前你所失的母驴，不必担心，都已找着了。此外，以色列所有的至宝是谁的呢？岂不是你和你父亲全家的吗？”

text_en: Saul answered, “I am only a Benjaminite, from the least of the tribes of Israel, and my family is the humblest of all the families of the tribe of Benjamin. Why then have you spoken to me in this way? ”
text_cn: 撒乌耳回答说：“我岂不是一个本雅明人，属于以色列最小的一支派吗？我的家族在本雅明家族中，不也是最小的吗？你怎能向我说出这样的话？”

text_en: Then Samuel took Saul and his servant-boy and brought them into the hall, and gave them a place at the head of those who had been invited, of whom there were about thirty.
text_cn: 以后撒慕尔将撒乌耳和他的仆人领到餐厅内，叫他们坐在宾客的首位上，宾客约有三十人。

text_en: And Samuel said to the cook, “Bring the portion I gave you, the one I asked you to put aside. ”
text_cn: 撒慕尔对厨师说：“将我交给你的那一份，即对你说：暂且留下的那一份，给我拿来。”

text_en: The cook took up the thigh and what went with it and set them before Saul. Samuel said, “See, what was kept is set before you. Eat; for it is set before you at the appointed time, so that you might eat with the guests. ” So Saul ate with Samuel that day.
text_cn: 厨师遂把后腿和肥尾端上来，放在撒乌耳面前。撒慕尔对他说：“看，摆在你面前的，是预先特意保留的一份，请吃吧！因为特意为你保留下的，叫你好同宾客一起吃。”撒乌耳那天就同撒慕尔一起吃了饭。

text_en: When they came down from the shrine into the town, a bed was spread for Saul on the roof, and he lay down to sleep.
text_cn: 他们从高丘下到城里，有人在露台上给撒乌耳铺好了卧榻，

text_en: Then at the break of dawn Samuel called to Saul upon the roof, “Get up, so that I may send you on your way. ” Saul got up, and both he and Samuel went out into the street.
text_cn: 撒乌耳就睡在那里。天一亮，撒慕尔就叫醒在露台上的撒乌耳，对他说：起来，让我送你走。”撒乌耳起来，他们二人，即他和撒慕尔，就往城外走；

text_en: As they were going down to the outskirts of the town, Samuel said to Saul, “Tell the boy to go on before us, and when he has passed on, stop here yourself for a while, that I may make known to you the word of God. ”
text_cn: 当他们下到城边时，撒慕尔对撒乌耳说：“你吩咐仆人，叫他在我们前面先走，你暂且停留一会，我要把天主的话告诉你。”
